_comment: Curated read-only snapshot served by /web/api/domain/*. This is a SAMPLE, not the live graph — set AURA_WEB_LIVE_DOMAIN=1 to serve the real Project Brain instead (self-host only).

projects.name: AURA
projects.summary: The companion itself — voice, memory, presence, and the Domain OS it runs on.

blocker.title: Two response paths have drifted apart
blocker.detail: brain.process() and brain.process_streaming() duplicate context assembly. Every fix has to land twice, and one of them is always behind.

features.name: Conversation core
features.note: Streaming path is the one the UI uses; the sync path lags.

features.name: Voice I/O
features.note: Wake word, STT, per-voice TTS with in-app picker.

features.name: Durable memory
features.note: SQLite: conversations, facts, notes, recaps, tasks.

features.name: Project Brain (Domain)
features.note: Graph + git scan + planning + progress wired; timeline views partial.

features.name: Attention & presence
features.note: Nudges and energy meter live; AFK roaming still pending.

features.name: Web surface
features.note: Public landing page + sandboxed browser demo.

timeline.title: Real model routing
timeline.detail: Intent picks the model; the UI chip shows the one actually used.

timeline.title: One-click launch
timeline.detail: AURA.bat boots Electron, which boots the server itself.

timeline.title: Project brain in every turn
timeline.detail: work_recall injects the graph into the prompt, so 'where did we leave off' answers from data, not a guess.

timeline.title: Groq retired the llama models
timeline.detail: Every call 404'd. Moved to gpt-oss + an explicit model allow-list.

timeline.title: Named chat sessions
timeline.detail: Switchable chats, context follows the switch, replies speak.
